snippet.title: Two dead after car being pursued by police crashes with their vehicle
snippet.description:
Two people have died and four people have been arrested after a BMW that was being pursued by police collided with a Volkswagen in Leeds.

A chase began at 12.44am on Sunday after a blue BMW 123D failed to stop for a police vehicle in Leeds, West Yorkshire Police said.

The driver of the Volkswagen, a 22-year-old man from York, died at the scene and a passenger in the same car, a 23-year-old woman, also from York, was pronounced dead in hospital a short time later, the force said.

West Yorkshire Police has referred itself to the Independent Office for Police Conduct, which has declared an independent investigation.

ADVERTENCIA! - Que encontraras en Jardred?

En Jardred encontrarás vídeos de Minecraft cuidadosamente preparados y guionizados, creados con el único propósito de ofrecer historias entretenidas para el público. El contenido está dirigido a toda la familia: aunque los personajes son caóticos y las situaciones pueden ser intensas, nunca se transmiten mensajes negativos a la audiencia. Todo está pensado para entretener tanto a los más pequeños como a los más mayores.

El canal se inspira en múltiples creadores de la plataforma de YouTube, pero siempre con un enfoque propio y original, buscando que cada historia tenga una identidad única que no pueda encontrarse en ningún otro canal. Publicamos contenido diario de Minecraft en formato largo y Shorts, pensado para todo tipo de público.

PERSONAJES:

JARDRED
Una calabaza viviente caótica, con cambios de humor constantes. Al mínimo enfado recurre a la dinamita para hacerlo volar todo por los aires, aunque intenta controlar sus impulsos. Adora a los gatos y, aunque no lo admita, es muy miedoso con todo lo relacionado con el terror. Aprecia profundamente a sus amigos, aunque rara vez lo demuestra, prefiriendo expresar su cariño a través de bromas extremas y situaciones absurdas.

MAURICIO
El aldeano principal y más conocido de la aldea. Es el acompañante habitual de Jardred en casi todas sus aventuras, aunque a menudo termina agotado por su comportamiento y necesita tiempo a solas. Le apasionan los negocios y ganar dinero; su pasatiempo favorito es jugar en el ordenador. Trabaja diariamente organizando y distribuyendo las tareas entre los aldeanos del reino.

PABLO
El único aldeano que viste una túnica blanca. Es un científico apasionado por la naturaleza y los animales, siempre experimentando, aunque muchas veces sus pruebas acaban en situaciones inesperadas. A pesar de su pasado tímido, ahora no tolera que nadie se burle de él y siempre está dispuesto a ayudar a sus amigos cuando se encuentran en problemas.

ALMUDENA
La única aldeana que viste una túnica rosa. Es la líder de los ejércitos de la aldea, aunque actualmente dispone de más tiempo libre desde que el Rey Aldeano ha comenzado a sustituir el ejército tradicional por agentes de policía bajo su mando. Tiene un carácter fuerte y autoritario, y no soporta que le lleven la contraria cuando sabe que tiene razón.

JARD
El clon malvado de Jardred. En el pasado fue la criatura más poderosa de Minecraft, capaz de corromper y controlar mundos y criaturas a su antojo. Actualmente vive en la aldea con solo una pequeña parte de sus antiguos poderes, intentando llevar una vida normal. En esta nueva etapa, se encuentra estudiando programación.

snippet.description:
Men have nipples because all human fetuses start with the same basic body plan before sex differentiation occurs.

Early in development, nipples form before the Y chromosome directs the body toward male sex characteristics. This physiological blueprint remains constant, meaning these structures persist even after hormonal changes define gender.

While typically dormant, the right hormonal conditions could theoretically allow for lactation. Understanding this aspect of human anatomy provides a clear look at how early gestation sets the stage for our physical features.

snippet.description:
🕵️‍♂️❓ Where is Donald Trump? Sean Duffy's answer suggests his own staff doesn't know either. ❓🕵️‍♂️

🤫 THE SILENCE
It's not like we miss the gurgling nonsense. 💨 The joy of a normal presidency with a competent cabinet is not having to worry when things go quiet. But this is an upside-down cuckoo-time presidency, staffed by a collection of monster people Charles Addams would've rejected for being too ghoulish. 🦇

✈️ A NATIONAL CRISIS
On Friday, the FAA grounded flights nationwide for more than four hours, stranding travelers across the country. 🛑 The president didn't address the nation. His only reported comment came secondhand, in a phone call with Fox News, blaming a "bunch of old broken stuff." 📞

🎬 MEANWHILE, ON TRUTH SOCIAL
As the country dealt with the fallout, Trump's evening posts were about the Coast Guard and his plan to "save Hollywood." 🍿 Then: silence. 😶

✨ DUFFY'S ANSWER
Asked why Americans hadn't heard from the president, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, "I don't run the president's comms," and offered only vague assurances that they had spoken. 🙃 Big "no honey, it's glitter from an arts-and-crafts bachelor party" energy. 💅

Trump has reportedly cleared his weekend schedule and skipped his usual trip to Mar-a-Lago. 🏰 He hasn't been seen in public in about 72 hours. It's not like he's hiding from his family at Thanksgiving. He's hiding from all of us. 🦃 What's going on?

snippet.title: Berrak'ın yeni yalanı! - Güller ve Günahlar 41. Bölüm
snippet.description:
Dürüstlük, aile bağları ve güven üzerine kurduğu hayatıyla tanınan başarılı iş insanı Serhat, eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir gerçeği öğrenince sarsılır. Berrak’ın geçirdiği talihsiz kaza sonrası komaya girmesi, Serhat’ı yanıtlarını bulmak için zorlu bir yolculuğa çıkarır. Bu süreçte, yoksul bir mahallenin cesur ve açık sözlü kızı Zeynep ile yolları kesişir. Farklı dünyalara ait Serhat ve Zeynep, ihanet, aşk ve gizli sırların gölgesinde aynı fırtınaya kapılır. Kalplerinin çağrısına karşı koymaya çalışsalar da, geçmişin karanlık yüzü onları geri dönüşü olmayan bir yola sürükler.  

Güller ve Günahlar’da Murat Yıldırım başarılı iş insanı Serhat karakteri ile Cemre Baysel ise fakir mahallenin cesur ve dobra kızı Zeynep rolüyle izleyici karşısına çıkmaya hazırlanıyor. İkiliye önemli rollerde Oya Unustası, Gülenay Kalkan, Serdar Orçin, Emel Çölgecen, Ahmet Saraçoğlu, Aleyna Solaker, Kaan Çakır, Serdar Özer, Gizem Sevim, Neslihan Arslan, Emre Özcan, Merve Su Bengi ve Mina Akdin gibi yıldızlar kadrosu eşlik ediyor. Dizinin sevimli yıldızlarına ise Beren Gençalp ve Yade Arayıcı hayat veriyor.
Deniz Can Çelik yönetmenliğinde ekrana gelecek olan Güller ve Günahlar, hayatını dürüstlük, aile sevgisi ve güven üzerine kuran Serhat’ın (Murat Yıldırım), eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir sırrı öğrenmesiyle alt üst olan hayatına odaklanıyor. Serhat’ın yolu, dobra ve cesur tavırlarıyla dikkat çeken Zeynep’le (Cemre Baysel) kesiştiğinde ikili kendilerini büyük bir fırtınanın içinde buluyor.

snippet.title: 5 Mass Extinctions — How EARTH Chose Humans #tarunshorts #evolution
snippet.description:
Earth is 4.54 billion years old, and in that time life has been nearly wiped out five times. Every mass extinction removed the ruling species and handed the throne to a new one.
This short tells the story of 5 extinctions and 6 kings:
- End-Ordovician (444 million years ago): Endoceras, a squid relative with a 6-metre shell, ruled the seas. An ice age killed about 85% of species. Fossils from that ancient sea are found today in India's Spiti Valley.
- Late Devonian (372 million years ago): Dunkleosteus, a one-tonne armoured fish with self-sharpening bony jaws.
- End-Permian, "The Great Dying" (252 million years ago): Inostrancevia, a tiger-sized sabre-toothed predator and a distant relative of mammals. The Siberian Traps killed about 9 in 10 marine species.
- End-Triassic (201 million years ago): crocodile-line archosaurs such as Postosuchus ruled the land. Their fall opened a reign of more than 130 million years for the dinosaurs.
- End-Cretaceous (66 million years ago): a 10-km asteroid struck with the energy of roughly 4.5 billion Hiroshima bombs, while India's Deccan Traps poured out vast lava flows. Small mammals survived, and we descend from them.

Today humans rule because of intelligence. Could AI be the next contender?

Sources: NSF; ScienceDaily (Engelman 2023); Live Science; Biology Letters (Anderson & Westneat 2007); USGS; PIB / Geological Survey of India; Our World in Data.
